// Arcade versus map MAGMA — generated by tools/mapgen/genlava.py, do not hand-edit.
//
// Stone banks (grass) either side of a river of lava (fence: nobody walks into it, shots fly over it), a volcano
// in the corner (basalt walls round a lava crater); the river is crossed by a ford by way of an island, the main
// bridge and a lava tube walled in basalt (street). Not mirrored: every point is about as far from either start.
// Nothing here is for sale.
//
// Tiles    =  lava   ;  stone (walkable)   _  bridge   #  basalt (columns, the volcano, the tube)   ,  the world's edge
//          T  obsidian spire and  x  basalt boulder (block walking and bullets)
// Objects  1 and 2 are where the two teams start; A, B and C are the capture points;
//          b  ash cloud (walkable, hides you from enemies more than 2 tiles away)

[legend]
theme lava
name MAGMA
P start
1 team 0
2 team 1
A point A
B point B
C point C
b bush
t furniture table
s furniture shelf
d furniture bed
o furniture stove
r furniture barrel
c furniture chest
[grid]
